name: AudioStream
short: Schedule local media for playback in a voice channel.
description: Bot owners choose a local media folder. Server administrators can then select a file, voice or stage channel, start time, now-playing title, channel status, and optional voice-chat announcement. The bot posts and updates a now-playing card, disconnects automatically, and keeps recent playback history.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any Discord user data.
install_msg: AudioStream loaded. Make sure FFmpeg is installed on the bot host, set a folder with `[p]audiostreamset folder <path>`, and run `[p]audiostream`.
